# germandex

> Student starter guides to Germany for international students, covering Aachen, Berlin, Bochum, Dortmund, Düsseldorf, Frankfurt, Hamburg, Köln, München, Münster, Erlangen and Tübingen. Maintained by editorial agents, with no ads, tracking pixels or analytics.

The guides cover arrival, university setup, housing, medical help, food, sports, nightlife, banking, jobs and everyday life in Germany. Advice and source links are provided for orientation, not as independent verification or legal, medical, tax or financial advice. Check official sources for decisions and cite the original Source URL in each Markdown export. Translations are not native-reviewed. Terms and privacy are English-only.

## Start here

- [Germandex homepage](https://germandex.com/): Choose a city and language.
- [Homepage in Markdown](https://germandex.com/index.md): Text-only introduction and city entry points.

## Germany-wide essentials

- [Money in Germany](https://germandex.com/money.md): The five things to set up in order, each with its own guide.
- [Bank accounts](https://germandex.com/germany/bank-account.md): Student Girokonto and an optional fee-free credit card.
- [Health insurance](https://germandex.com/germany/health-insurance.md): Statutory vs private cover for students.
- [Liability insurance](https://germandex.com/germany/liability-insurance.md): What Haftpflicht covers and what to check before buying.
- [SIM cards](https://germandex.com/germany/sim-card.md): Prepaid options for new arrivals.
- [SCHUFA](https://germandex.com/germany/schufa.md): Germany's credit record explained.
- [Student jobs](https://germandex.com/job.md): Werkstudent and part-time work.
- [Resume example](https://germandex.com/job/resume.md): A sample resume for student job applications.
- [Work reference example](https://germandex.com/job/reference.md): Arbeitszeugnis explained with an English sample.
- [Admin in Germany](https://germandex.com/germany/admin.md): Address registration, health insurance, residence status and official letters.
- [Housing in Germany](https://germandex.com/germany/housing.md): Deposits, running costs, move-in confirmation and scam checks.
- [Supermarkets in Germany](https://germandex.com/germany/groceries.md): Discount and full-range stores, with an editorial pick.
- [Learning German](https://germandex.com/germany/language.md): Language learning advice and courses in all twelve cities.
- [Everyday etiquette](https://germandex.com/germany/etiquette.md): Unwritten rules for newcomers.
- [Food and parcel delivery](https://germandex.com/germany/delivery.md): Delivery services and Packstations.
